title: Novel triphenylamine-based polyimides as promising organic cathode for lithium/sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7750-7757
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08855G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lizhen Zeng, Yibo Chen, Xiaotong Deng, Dan Li, Zhe Wang, Haidong Liu, Shizhu Liu, Alice A. Kasera, Ronghua Zeng
A novel poly(4-aminotriphenylamine-3,3′,4,4′-benzophenone tetramide) (PTNBI) organic cathode for lithium/sodium-ion batteries has been synthesized, which can effectively reduce dissolution in organic electrolytes and improve the discharge platform.
